entity.summary: Self-custody Bitcoin ecosystem wallet from Secret Key Labs, distributed as iOS/Android mobile applications and a desktop browser extension.
entity.notes: Contemporaneous 2021 evidence establishes the Xverse mobile-wallet lineage: a commissioned security audit identifies Secret Key Labs' Xverse Wallet mobile application and App Store distribution evidence confirms public availability during 2021. WLR therefore records the entity launch at 2021 year precision without asserting one exact original store-release day.

products.summary: Xverse self-custody mobile wallet for iOS and Android.
products.notes: Contemporaneous 2021 evidence establishes the Xverse mobile-wallet lineage: Least Authority completed a commissioned security audit of Secret Key Labs' Xverse Wallet mobile application in August 2021, and Apple App Store distribution evidence shows public Xverse user activity in November 2021. Xverse's own April 2022 history then describes the product as an iOS/Android mobile wallet after a recent rebrand. WLR records 2021 at year precision without inferring one exact initial App Store or Play Store publication day.

products.summary: Xverse desktop browser-extension wallet launched in December 2022 and currently distributed for Chrome-compatible desktop browsers.
products.notes: The extension has a security lifecycle distinct from the mobile application.

events.title: Xverse desktop browser extension launched
events.description: Xverse launched its desktop browser extension in beta for Chrome, adding a desktop wallet product alongside the existing mobile wallet.

events.title: Xverse Extension local seed-phrase logging issue disclosed
events.description: Xverse disclosed that browser behavior could cause a seed phrase to be written unencrypted to a local Chrome log during extension onboarding under certain conditions.
events.notes: Xverse stated the seed phrase never left the local device, mobile users were not affected, no exploits were reported, and no user funds were lost. Version 0.11.4 prevented new local logging; 0.11.5 additionally provided cleanup of previously cached logs.

events.title: Xverse Mobile publicly available during 2021
events.description: Contemporaneous audit and mobile-store distribution evidence establish the Xverse Wallet mobile product during 2021.
events.notes: Year precision only. The reviewed evidence safely establishes public mobile availability during 2021 but does not justify one exact initial store-release day.

evidence.title: Xverse End User License Agreement
evidence.notes: Primary legal source identifying Secret Key Labs Limited as the company behind the Xverse application.

evidence.title: Download Xverse Wallet for Android, iOS & Chrome
evidence.notes: Current first-party download page separates the browser extension from iOS/Android mobile apps.

evidence.title: Xverse Launches Desktop Browser Extension
evidence.notes: Primary launch announcement for the desktop browser extension.

evidence.title: Security Notice: Chrome Extension Encryption Issue
evidence.notes: Primary disclosure for the local seed-phrase logging issue, mobile exclusion, no reported losses, and 0.11.4/0.11.5 mitigations.

evidence.title: Introducing Xverse: the Gateway to the Stacks Ecosystem
evidence.notes: First-party historical source describing Xverse as a non-custodial iOS/Android mobile wallet before the desktop extension launch.

evidence.title: Secret Key Labs – Xverse Wallet
evidence.notes: Contemporaneous commissioned audit identifying Xverse Wallet as Secret Key Labs’ mobile wallet application. Establishes the 2021 mobile product lineage; distribution evidence is used separately to establish public availability during the year.

evidence.title: Xverse: Bitcoin Crypto Wallet — Apple App Store
evidence.publisher: Apple App Store / Secret Key Labs
evidence.notes: Primary distribution-platform listing for the Secret Key Labs Xverse app includes public user review activity dated 2021-11-21. Used only to establish public availability during 2021, not to claim that date as the original release date.
